visualCharacteristics.purpose: pull quote with quote mark, quote text and byline (avatar, name, role)
visualCharacteristics.layout: with a background row: photo band under a navy scrim, white text; without one (quote-plain, set by the block): navy text on the page ground inside an article column
visualCharacteristics.notes: quote-plain is derived from content (no background row), not an author option.

contentPattern.structure: rows classified by content: optional background <picture> row; quote text paragraph(s); byline row (avatar <picture>, name p, role p)

usage: Pull-quote bands (PGA TOUR) and in-article pull quotes (our-stories).
reuseGuidance: Leave out the background row for an in-article quote on white.
